latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of "Generator in Hinglish — Create Videos in Hinglish".

- Instantly generate Hinglish narrated videos with subtitles by uploading MP4, MOV, TXT, or DOCX files (up to 200MB).
- Seamless onboarding: automatically connect to the API and handle authentication for you.
- Supports text prompts for video generation, export, credits check, and more; works with common Indian and English phrases.
- 1–2 minute turnaround for most video generations, rendered server-side — no software to install.
- Session-based workflows allow iterative editing, previews, and batch processing.
- Optimized for Indian content creators seeking conversational Hinglish videos for local audiences.
